data.title: 小木曾雪菜 · 胶带粘住了海风
data.description: 临时表演摊的节目纸被风掀起一角。雪菜把胶带扯出一段，抬手压住高处的纸边。背后的木台还没人站，只有试音箱外亮着一盏绿灯。
data.location: 海滨夏日活动的木舞台旁
data.action: 踮脚将纸节目单用胶带贴在木板上
data.lighting: 海面反光照亮木板，试音箱亮着小绿灯
data.mood: 专心，在上台前做最后一件小事
data.promptProse: Setsuna stretches up to tape a fluttering program to a notice board beside the beach stage. The navy neckerchief and sailor-collared swimsuit are paired with the pleated skirt from the outfit. A small speaker sits at the edge of the platform while late light grazes her raised hand.
data.animaCaption: She pins the paper with her palm long enough for a strip of tape to hold its corner down.
